name: edi-ftp
description: Read EDI files from an FTP, FTPS or SFTP server: list a remote directory, fetch or peek a file, inspect an undocumented tracciato, and parse fixed-width, delimited or EDIFACT/X12 files into records — with a reusable layout, or with the structure inferred when there is none. Connection profiles are stored locally with the password encrypted at rest.
author: ettore@example.com
